mechanism_narrative: A declining federal funds rate trend consistently compresses equity discount rates, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days without requiring specific triggering conditions.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods where FEDFUNDS declines, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises above 5.5% in a 3-month window, it signals deteriorating labor market conditions that trigger a flight to safety, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in residential investment (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) signal a collapsing housing market, which triggers a negative S&P 500 forward return over the next 60 trading days due to reduced consumer spending and wealth effects.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of periods where both RSAFS and HOUST decline, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of declining industrial production (INDPRO < 95), manufacturing sector weakness reduces corporate earnings growth expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of periods where INDPRO < 95, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payroll employment (PAYEMS) growth consistently signals strong labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate profits, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days without requiring specific triggering conditions.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods where PAYEMS growth is positive, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the year-over-year CPI inflation rate exceeds 3.0%, it signals persistent inflation that triggers central bank tightening, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of declining consumer spending (RSAFS < 0% YoY), weak retail demand reduces corporate revenue expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of periods where RSAFS YoY < 0.0%, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 100.0 in a 3-month window, it signals a manufacturing contraction that reduces corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.
